free_tier.stated: Stores contributor *classifications*, not contributor *uploads* — and the upload side is capped at 10,000 subjects per user. Zooniverse Help, Lab Policies, verbatim: 'there is a limit of 10,000 subject uploads per user. Please contact us if you'd like to upload more.'

egress.terms: free read, but only per-subject image URLs — no bulk export endpoint without project-owner credentials

interface_detail: Panoptes API (api.zooniverse.org); project builder; subject sets
tooling: panoptes-client (Ruby/JS); subject uploader UI; no bulk CLI
chaining: None. Each project's subjects live in a project-scoped S3 bucket; the data exports are CSV manifests, not a filesystem.

limits.value: review and a one-week beta before launch

limits_note: 10,000 subjects/user; every project passes a two-stage review and a one-week beta before launch; media must be licensed and rights-clear

identity_cost.detail: email for a volunteer account ('Only your name and email are captured'), but publishing a project is `write-gated` — internal review + beta test + launch scheduling, typically weeks.

reliability_note: Dead as a storage target for a user. It is a volunteer-compute platform: the storage is incidental to the classification task and cannot be addressed as a bucket.

evidence.proved: 'there is a limit of 10,000 subject uploads per user'; two-stage review before launch
